entities.name: Homura, Human Ascendant
entities.description: Legendary human monk of Kamigawa during the Kami War who granted dragon power to allies and ascended to become Homura's Essence.

entities.name: Homura's Essence
entities.description: Legendary enchantment into which Homura ascended, the focused essence of his mortal form.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: Conflict on Kamigawa during which Homura lived.

events.summary: After ascending, Homura becomes Homura's Essence.
events.quote: After ascending, Homura became become a powerful, legendary enchantment
